description: This file defines API routes for managing projects within a web application, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting projects, and managing project members, using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object used to define project-related API endpoints.

methods.name: List[ProjectOut] list_my_projects( db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all projects where the current user is owner or member.

methods.name: ProjectOut create_project_endpoint( payload: ProjectCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new project owned by the current user.

methods.name: ProjectOut get_project_endpoint( project_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific project by ID.

methods.name: ProjectOut update_project_endpoint( project_id: int, payload: ProjectUpdate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update fields of an existing project.

methods.name: None delete_project_endpoint( project_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a project (owner only).

methods.name: ProjectMemberOut add_member_endpoint( project_id: int, payload: ProjectMemberAdd, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add or update a project member.

methods.name: None remove_member_endpoint( project_id: int, user_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a member from a project.
